description: Permutation test that the empirical eigenvalue spectrum differs from the column-scrambled null, targeting the top of the spectrum.
null_hypothesis: genes are mutually independent (no gene-gene correlation)
null_construction: independent permutation of each gene (column) across cells; reproduces src/analysis_functions.scramble

parameters.z_transform: column-wise, ddof=0 -> (1/n)M'M is the Pearson correlation matrix with trace exactly p
parameters.eigen_solver: numpy.linalg.eigvalsh on the n x n Gram matrix (1/n)MM'

pvalue_method.primary: parametric: MLE fit of a distribution family to the B scrambled lambda_k, then p = SF_fitted(lambda_obs_k)
pvalue_method.family_selection: AIC over norm, skewnorm, gamma, genextreme, gumbel_r, lognorm
pvalue_method.reported_band: log10_p_min (lightest tail) to log10_p_max (heaviest tail) across all converged families
pvalue_method.theory: for the largest eigenvalue of a Wishart-type null the limiting law is Tracy-Widom (beta=1), right tail exp(-(2/3)s^{3/2}); heavier than the normal tail exp(-s^2/2) and lighter than the Gumbel tail exp(-s), so the normal and Gumbel fits bracket the Tracy-Widom answer
pvalue_method.gamma_note: the 3-parameter gamma is included because the Chiani (2014) approximation to Tracy-Widom is a shifted, scaled gamma, so a free gamma fit can reach a Tracy-Widom-shaped solution
pvalue_method.secondary: empirical permutation p = (1 + #{null >= obs}) / (B + 1), censored at 1/(B+1)
pvalue_method.calibration: held-out PIT check: fit on half the null draws, map the other half through the fitted CDF, KS against Uniform(0,1); validates the fit over its observable range only
pvalue_method.caveat: p below 1/B extrapolates beyond the support of the null sample; its value is determined by the assumed tail shape, so report the band

statistics.z_k: (lambda_obs[k] - null_mean[k]) / null_sd[k], null moments from the B replicates
statistics.maxT: max over k<=20 of z_k, maximized within each replicate (FWER control across ranks)
statistics.k_hat: parallel analysis: number of leading eigenvalues above the null 95th percentile at their own rank, scanned over the first all ranks (k_hat_censored flags samples that reach the scan limit)
